leadText:
A Psychic (Japanese: サイキッカー Psychicer) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that first debuted in the Generation I games. They were originally only male, but in Generation III, female Psychics started to appear. In Generation VI, the Trainer class once again reverts to all male, having found a female counterpart in s. They appear as young men or young women levitating s with their psychokinetic powers.

When paired with s in Double Battles, they are called s.

As their name suggests, they specialize in Pokémon, though they occasionally also use Pokémon from Generation III onward.

==In animation==
 
A number of Psychics were seen in the Saffron Gym in Abra and the Psychic Showdown.

Another Psychic appeared much later in Glory Blaze! as one of the participants of the Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition. There, he was partnered with a and faced off against and Paul in the quarterfinals. Despite the two working well as a team, they were unable to contend against the experienced Trainers and were knocked out.

A Psychic named Ricky appeared in Climbing the Tower of Success!. He is based on a Psychic named Bryce, who appeared in the Celestial Tower in the .

A large number of Psychics who train under Olympia appeared in Cloudy Fate, Bright Future!. They included and Charlene.

===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
A male Psychic made a cameo appearance in a flashback in Punching Poliwrath as one of the Trainers that wanted to challenge to a battle after his win at the Indigo League, but he was considered to be a "boring" match.

==== ====
A male Psychic was seen amongst the people visiting the in Weavile Wobbles But It Won't Fall Down.

==== ====
A male Psychic was one of the people swarming the Mossdeep Space Center in Diancie Shines.

==== ====
In Dream a Little Dream, a male and a female Psychic were seen as two of the 32 participants of the tournament, going through . They were eventually defeated off-panel, eliminating them from the tournament.

==== ====
In Sylveon Enchants, a Psychic was seen at the Mini-game Corner.

====Pokémon====
 

 

 

 

===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
In Find Munchlax!!, a female Psychic is one of the three Trainers searching for . She uses her psychic powers to sense Munchlax's presence but only manages to find Hareta.
 

==Trivia==
In the Pokémon Gold and Silver Spaceworld '97 demo, the Psychic class was renamed to (Japanese: ちょうのうりょくしゃ Chōnōryokusha, transl. Extrasensory Perception User), but was reverted in the final release.
There are no female Psychics outside of the in .
In , all female Psychics that can be battled are found in the Sevii Islands.
In Pokémon X and Y, Psychic Robert makes a reference to a meme spawned by the anime series, as he claims that the player and their Pokémon's power level is "over 9000". This reference is not present in the Japanese version.
In Pokémon GO, "Psychic" is the name of an achievement awarded for catching at least 10 Pokémon.
